title: ChatGPT is now a partner for your most ambitious work
summary: ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.
body: ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了ChatGPT Work作为一款新型AI Agent，能够跨越不同的应用程序与本地文件主动执行任务。它支持长时间维持项目上下文，将抽象的用户目标转化为最终可交付的实际工作成果。原始信息显示：ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“ChatGPT is now a partner for your most ambitious work”。其重要性主要体现在：该文章介绍了ChatGPT向能够跨应用和文件执行任务的Agent形态演进，反映了AI助手向自主工作流转变的趋势。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
